text.title: Google Ads Campaign Setup Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for Google Ads Campaign Setup: the five generic steps, then the account and tracking setup, campaign configuration, the four launch checklists (pre-launch, campaign setup, ad groups and ads, extensions), the go-live gate with `templates/launch-gate.py`, and human-in-loop checkpoints. Each step lists input, action, output, and a decision-gate to the next step.

step.name: inventory-inputs
step.input: task brief, prior artefact (if any), source-of-truth access
step.action: Collect inputs named in AGENTS.md Prerequisites table; verify access; capture timestamps.
step.output: Inputs index with source citations; access blockers surfaced.
step.decision-gate: All inputs reachable? If no -> skip per AGENTS.md Skip If.

step.name: apply-rules
step.action: Walk each rule in `01-core-rules.xml`. Verify each is satisfied. Note violations.
step.decision-gate: Any rule-violation that blocks the methodology? If yes -> skip OR remediate before continuing.

step.name: walk-decision-tree
step.action: Open `06-decision-tree.xml`. Evaluate root question and traverse branches until a `<conclusion>` is reached.
step.output: Decision-record-style note: branch path + conclusion + rule id referenced.
step.decision-gate: Decision = skip-this-methodology? If yes -> log skip reason and exit. Else -> continue.

step.name: draft-artefact
step.action: Draft per `02-output-contract.xml`. Fill schema-required fields. Anchor every non-trivial field to >= 1 evidence entry.
step.output: Draft artefact (JSON or Markdown sidecar matching schema).
step.decision-gate: All required fields populated? Evidence cited? If no -> iterate.

step.name: validate-and-handoff
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-ads-google-campaign-setup.py --file <artefact>`. Resolve violations. Set status to ready_for_review. Notify named consumer.
step.output: Validator OK + status=ready_for_review + handoff note delivered.
step.decision-gate: Validator exit 0? Consumer acknowledged? If no -> fix and re-validate.

step.name: account-and-tracking
step.action: Create Google Ads account. Link to Google Analytics 4. Create conversion actions (purchase, lead, sign-up, call, install). Install Google Tag (gtag.js) or GTM container.
step.output: Account with conversion actions and tag installed.
step.decision-gate: Verify Tag Assistant shows conversions firing before launch. Not firing in the last 24 hours? -> stop (conversion-tracking-first rule).

step.name: configure-campaign
step.input: Campaign spec, campaign type (default Search, see `content/05-examples.xml`)
step.action: Campaign name: [Product]_[Type]_[Goal]_[Date] — enforced via regex. Networks: Search only (disable Display and Search Partners explicitly). Locations: target market specifically (use geoTargetConstants/<id>, not country name strings). Languages: match content language. Bidding: Maximize Conversions (no target CPA) for first 30 conversions. Budget: minimum $20-50/day; $1/day budget signals a unit error (1,000,000 micros = $1). Status: always create as PAUSED; require explicit go-live step.
step.output: PAUSED campaign with every setting explicit (every-setting-explicit rule).
step.decision-gate: amount_micros == dollars * 1,000,000 and all three network flags false? If no -> fix before ad groups.

section.title: Launch checklists (expand step 5)

step.name: checklist-pre-launch
step.action: Conversion tracking installed and verified firing in last 24 hours. Google Analytics 4 linked to Google Ads account. Remarketing audience created from website visitors. Campaign spec YAML/JSON written and validated against schema.
step.decision-gate: Any item unticked? If yes -> do not create the campaign.

step.name: checklist-campaign-setup
step.action: Campaign type: Search. Network: Search only (Display and Search Partners explicitly disabled). Locations: geoTargetConstants/<id> format (not country name strings). Languages: configured explicitly. Budget: set in micros (dollars * 1,000,000). Bidding: Maximize Conversions, no Target CPA for first 30 conversions. Status: PAUSED. start_date and end_date: set explicitly (default end_date is forever).
step.decision-gate: Any item unticked? If yes -> fix the campaign resource, re-run.

step.name: checklist-ad-groups-and-ads
step.action: One ad group per keyword theme. 10-20 keywords per ad group, same intent. Minimum 1 RSA per ad group with 15 headlines and 4 descriptions. Headline character limits validated (30 chars each). Description character limits validated (90 chars each). Keyword included in at least one headline per RSA.
step.output: Six ad-group items ticked; Ad Strength Good or Excellent per RSA.
step.decision-gate: Any RSA under 15 headlines or over character limits? If yes -> reject the ad (rsa-15-headlines-required rule).

step.name: checklist-extensions
step.action: Sitelinks: 4-6 at account or campaign level. Callouts: 4-6 at account or campaign level. Structured snippets: at least one category. Images: logo and product images. Extensions use Asset resources (not deprecated Extension resources).
step.decision-gate: Any asset created through the Extension service? If yes -> recreate as Asset (asset-resources-not-extension-service rule).

step.name: go-live-gate
step.action: Run `templates/launch-gate.py`; require all items to pass (launch-gate-all-pass rule); then obtain human approval and flip status to ENABLED.
step.output: Gate report attached to the artefact; campaign ENABLED.
step.decision-gate: Gate exit 0 and human approval recorded? If no -> campaign stays PAUSED.

section.reference: Pre-flight check script: validates RSA count, network settings, budget unit, conversion tracking

step.name: human-checkpoints
step.input: Any proposed change to a live campaign
step.action: Enabling the campaign (status ENABLED): human approval required. Raising budget by more than 25%: human approval required. Switching bid strategy: human approval required. Opening a new geographic target: human approval required. Removing extensions: human approval required.
step.output: Named approval recorded before the API mutate call.
step.decision-gate: Approval present for the triggered checkpoint? If no -> do not mutate.
